title: Ziltivekimab Update Sparks Interest in Denmark
description: Interest in ziltivekimab surges in Denmark following news of a failed cardiovascular trial.

sources.title: Novo Nordisk Shares Drop After Drug Candidate Fails in Cardiovascular Trial
Novo Nordisk provides update on the ZEUS phase 3 trial in people with ASCVD, CKD and inflammation
BNP Paribas says Novo's share price drop of a low to mid single-digit percentage is justified

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Ziltivekimab is a drug candidate developed by Novo Nordisk.

sections.heading: Failed Trial
paragraphs: According to WSJ, Novo Nordisk shares dropped after the drug candidate ziltivekimab failed in a cardiovascular trial.

sections.heading: Phase 3 Trial
paragraphs: Yahoo Finance reports that Novo Nordisk provided an update on the ZEUS phase 3 trial involving ziltivekimab, which was conducted in people with ASCVD, CKD, and inflammation.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Marketscreener.com notes that BNP Paribas justified a low to mid single-digit percentage drop in Novo's share price following the trial results.

faq.a: Ziltivekimab is a drug candidate developed by Novo Nordisk.
The drug candidate ziltivekimab failed in a cardiovascular trial, leading to a drop in Novo Nordisk shares, as reported by WSJ.

faq.q: What was the ZEUS phase 3 trial?
faq.a: The ZEUS phase 3 trial, as covered by Yahoo Finance, involved ziltivekimab and was conducted in people with ASCVD, CKD, and inflammation.
